A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same HyPINO research work. All 27 pages of each version, including Appendices A and B, provide readable text, equations, tables and figures supporting comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original seven-benchmark evaluations, iterative-refinement and fine-tuning experiments, plus resolution-invariance and L-BFGS analyses in Appendix B.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark comparisons, convergence plots, the resolution ablation and L-BFGS results.

M1.justification: The Swin-based hypernetwork, target PINN architecture, mixed supervision, losses and residual-driven refinement procedure are unchanged. Revised descriptions of generating corrective PINNs agree with the procedure already specified in v2.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same synthetic training coverage and seven benchmarks: HT, HZ, HZ-G, PS-C, PS-L, PS-G and WV. Figure 7's revised Poisson–Boltzmann terminology matches the equation already stated in v2 Appendix B.3.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains U-Net, Poseidon, PINO and refined PINO comparisons. Fine-tuning experiments retain random and Reptile initializations. Changing UNet to U-Net is a naming correction.

E3.justification: Training budgets, curricula, model sizes, metrics, domain normalization and Adam/L-BFGS procedures are unchanged. The corrected ensemble-count prose agrees with the size-4 and size-11 comparisons already specified in v2 Figures 13–14.

E4.justification: The refinement trajectories and examples, ensemble fine-tuning comparisons, resolution-invariance ablation and L-BFGS initialization analysis all appear in both versions with unchanged evidence.

E5.justification: Run/seed disclosures and uncertainty reporting are unchanged. v4 adds no repeated-run counts, confidence intervals or significance tests, and retains the same numerical and graphical reporting.

E6.justification: Numerical entries in Tables 1 and 3–5 and the prediction/convergence plots are unchanged. For example, both versions report HT MSE of 2.3e-2 for HyPINO and 8.0e-5 after ten refinements. The abstract rephrases the existing greater-than-100-fold reduction.

T1.justification: The mathematical content of Equations 1–51 and Algorithm 1 is unchanged. The refinement-index edit and generalized ensemble-count wording restate existing mathematics; no assumptions, proofs or derivations are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and performance claims concerning mixed synthetic supervision, zero-shot generalization, residual refinement and fine-tuning. Wording changes do not substantively expand the stated linear, two-dimensional scope.

C2.justification: Section 4.3 changes the discussion's naive-ensemble comparison from independently trained models to independently generated target networks. This is a limited refinement of the interpretation; the synthetic-bias hypothesis, PS-L failure explanation and applicability limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix B.10 corrects the general HyPINO_i description from three corrective PINNs/four experts to i corrective PINNs/i+1 experts. This improves technical documentation consistency with existing equations and figure captions. Other implementation details and code/model access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 references 32 and 33 duplicate the same DeepXDE paper; v4 retains it as reference 32. Other edits correct bibliographic metadata and renumber citations. No distinct cited work or substantive research positioning is added or removed.

P1.justification: Limited edits clarify the abstract, introduction and refinement description, correct grammar, and standardize terminology such as U-Net and fine-tuning. Section ordering is retained. The first-page conference line changes to Preprint.

P2.justification: Figure 7's caption specifies Helmholtz-type (Poisson–Boltzmann), and Table 4's caption clarifies matching a HyPINO-initialized PINN's initial MSE. Other changes include label spelling and minor reflow; graphics, table structures and their placement are substantially unchanged.

improvement.justification: v4 clarifies residual inference, corrects Appendix B.10's general ensemble count, and improves caption precision and bibliography consistency. These corrections modestly improve readability and internal consistency. Empirical evidence is unchanged, and the abstract's five-benchmark fine-tuning claim still conflicts with Section 4.4's four wins, two ties and one loss.
